title: Prove reporting grain and exact aggregates
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. Reporting grain is one row per (sale_date, region). Joining a fact to repeated dimension rows can multiply a sale before aggregation; this is JOIN fanout. sy_expected_report independently defines sale_count and exact total for each day/region, rather than reusing the observed dimension join. Inspect dimension multiplicity and sy_report. FULL JOIN the expected and actual report on both grain columns; count missing/unexpected or differing sale_count/total once per joined row plus duplicated day/region groups. Purpose: prove business totals, including a valid zero-total group. RUN actually aggregates the fact/dimension join; if dimension rows are duplicated, rerunning still produces incorrect totals. Do not fix fanout by SUM(DISTINCT amount): different sales can have equal amounts.
learning_objectives: Prove reporting grain and exact aggregates
Justify conclusions using independent keys, exact values and observable evidence.
